storyline.text: Hello, I am Clark Kent Georpe. I hold a B.S. in Computer Engineering from Cebu Technological University.
My foundations are reinforced by TESDA certifications in Data Analytics, Java, IoT, and Web Design.
I engineer software. I build cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter, Dart, and Riverpod.
I forge physical hardware. I design single-sided PCBs in KiCad and fabricate them via CNC.
My greatest feat is my thesis, Project AGRI-3D: integrating Edge Impulse TinyML image annotation for weed detection with an automated Cartesian gantry.
